```{r load_dataset}
# 1. Download OpenStreetMap street data for a specific area
library(osmdata)
library(dodgr)

# Get street data formatted as an sf object for your city
street_network <- dodgr_streetnet(bbox = "Klamath Falls, Oregon", expand = 0.2)

# 2. Convert the map into a directed graph optimized for walking
graph <- weight_streetnet(street_network, wt_profile = "foot")

# 3. Calculate distance matrices or model walking reachability
vertices <- dodgr_vertices(graph)
# Now you can route thousands of origin-to-destination walks or calculate isochrones


```
```{r}
library(osmdata)
library(dodgr)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ── 1. Get & weight the street network ────────────────────────────────────────
street_network <- dodgr_streetnet(bbox = "Klamath Falls, Oregon", expand = 0.2)
graph <- weight_streetnet(street_network, wt_profile = "foot")
vertices <- dodgr_vertices(graph)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OPTION A: ggplot2 (fast, static, great for publication / export)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# dodgr edges carry from/to vertex IDs — join coords back in
edges_plot <- graph %>%
  left_join(vertices %>% select(id, x, y) %>% rename(from_id = id, x_from = x, y_from = y),
            by = c("from" = "from_id")) %>%
  left_join(vertices %>% select(id, x, y) %>% rename(to_id = id, x_to = x, y_to = y),
            by = c("to" = "to_id"))

ggplot(edges_plot) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to,
        colour = d_weighted),          # colour by weighted distance
    linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Weighted dist (m)") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  labs(title = "Klamath Falls — walkable street network",
       subtitle = "Edge colour = dodgr foot-profile weighted distance") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  colour = "grey50"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
  )

ggsave("klamath_street_network.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OPTION B: visNetwork (interactive — opens in RStudio Viewer / browser)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(visNetwork)

# visNetwork wants nodes = data.frame(id, label, x, y)
#             edges = data.frame(from, to, [optional aesthetics])

# --- nodes ---
# Use integer IDs that visNetwork can handle; keep a lookup to dodgr vertex IDs
node_lookup <- vertices %>%
  mutate(vis_id = row_number()) %>%           # integer key visNetwork needs
  select(vis_id, id, x, y)

vis_nodes <- node_lookup %>%
  transmute(
    id    = vis_id,
    label = "",                               # labels clutter street nets
    x     = x * 1e5,                         # visNetwork uses pixel-ish coords;
    y     = -y * 1e5,                        # negate y so north is up
    title = paste0("lon: ", round(x / 1e5, 5),
                   "<br>lat: ", round(-y / 1e5, 5))
  )

# --- edges ---
# Map dodgr from/to (character vertex IDs) → vis integer IDs
id_map <- setNames(node_lookup$vis_id, node_lookup$id)

# Subsample if the graph is very large (> ~50 k edges gets sluggish in browser)
graph_sub <- if (nrow(graph) > 50000) slice_sample(graph, n = 50000) else graph

vis_edges <- graph_sub %>%
  transmute(
    from  = id_map[from],
    to    = id_map[to],
    value = d_weighted,                       # edge thickness ∝ weighted dist
    title = paste0("dist: ", round(d, 1), " m  |  weighted: ", round(d_weighted, 1), " m")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(from), !is.na(to))

visNetwork(vis_nodes, vis_edges,
           main  = "Klamath Falls — walkable street network",
           width = "100%", height = "800px") %>%
  visEdges(
    color  = list(color = "#4a90d9", highlight = "#e74c3c"),
    smooth = FALSE,          # straight lines = much faster rendering
    width  = 0.5
  ) %>%
  visNodes(size = 2, color = list(background = "#2c3e50", border = "#2c3e50")) %>%
  visPhysics(enabled = FALSE) %>%           # CRITICAL — disable physics on a geo network
  visOptions(highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1, hover = TRUE)) %>%
  visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE, zoomView = TRUE) %>%
  visSave(file = "klamath_street_network.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

message("Saved → klamath_street_network.html")
```
